senses.gloss: ध्वान्त- + जाल ध्वान्त- + जाल, n. deep darkness, Daśak. in Chr. 187, 18.

ध्वंस् ध्वंस्, base of the pass. and some other forms, ध्वस्, i. 1, Ātm. (also Par., MBh. 1, 3596).
 1. To fall to pieces, to perish, Bhaṭṭ. 14, 55.
 2. To go away, MBh. 3, 12525.
 --Ptcple. of the pf. pass. ध्वस्त,
 1. Fallen, Rām. 3, 58, 38.
 2. Lost, 1, 58, 10.
 3. Hurt, 6, 20, 22.
 4. Disappeared 5, 21, 12.
 5. Covered, MBh. 10, 662.
 --Caus. ध्वंसय, []
 1. To fell, Rām. 5, 63, 23.
 2. To destroy, Daśak. in Chr. 188, 18.
 3. To interrupt, Rām. 2, 60, 15.
 --With the prep. अप अप,
 1. To go away, Hariv. 720.
 2. To cause to go away, MBh. 1, 5596. अपध्वस्त, Reviled, miserable, Mṛcch. 124, 3 (crazed, Wils.).
 --With अभि अभि, To attack, MBh. 5, 3230.
 --With उद् उद्, Caus. To cover, MBh. 13, 4817.
 --With समुद् सम्-उद्, To cover, Rām. 2, 42, 10.
 --With उप उप, pass. To be attacked, Suśr. 1, 21, 14.
 --With विनि वि-नि, विनिध्वस्त, Destroyed, Rām. 2, 125, 13 Gorr.
 --With परि परि, परिध्वस्त,
 1. Destroyed, Rām. 2, 33, 18.
 2. Covered, 2, 41, 11 Gorr.
 --With प्र प्र, प्रध्वस्त, Perished, Bhartṛ. 3, 26.
 --Caus.
 1. To cause to fall, MBh. 7, 1387.
 2. To destroy, 1529.
 --With प्रति प्रति, प्रति-ध्वस्त,
 1. Afflicted, MBh. 12, 3606.
 2. Left (?), 3717.
 --With वि वि, To crumble down, MBh. 12, 7978.
 2. To disperse, 5, 5877. विध्वस्त,
 1. Fallen, 3, 2668.
 2. Fallen to pieces, Rām. 2, 114, 6.
 3. Destroyed, MBh. 1, 7675.
 4. Whirled up, Rām. 6, 19, 12.
 --Caus.
 1. To break to pieces, MBh. 1, 8282.
 2. To crush, 3, 16501.
 3. To destroy, Rām. 5, 26, 37.
 4. To hurt, 3, 53, 51.
 --With प्रवि प्र-वि, प्रविध्वस्त,
 1. Thrown away, Rām. 6, 22, 26.
 2. Struck, Hariv. 10627.
 --Cf. perhaps Lat. vastus, vastare; O.H.G. wôsti; A.S. weste; Goth. driusan; A.S. dreosan, dysi, dyselic, dysig, dysian.

ध्वंस ध्वंस् + अ, m.
 1. Destruction, Prab. 82, 14.
 2. Loss, Pañc. i. d. 117.

ध्वंसन ध्वंस् + अन,
 I. adj. Destroying, [] MBh. 5, 5316.
 II. n. Destruction, Rām. 6, 38, 21.

ध्वंसिन् ध्वंस् + इन्, adj., f. नी.
 1. Perishing, Bhartṛ. 3, 35.
 2. Destroying, Hariv. 4627.

† ध्वज् ध्वज्, i. 1, Par. To go.
 --Cf. perhaps Lat. vagus, vagari.

ध्वज ध्वज, m. and n.
 1. A flag or banner, Rām. 2, 67, 26.
 2. A mark, a symbol, MBh. 1, 1511.
 3. A distiller's flag, Man. 4, 85.
 4. The penis, Suśr. 2, 114, 9.
 --Comp.

ध्वजवन्त् ध्वज + वन्त्,
 I. adj.
 1. Adorned with flags, Rām. 1, 5, 17.
 2. Branded, Yājñ. 3, 243.
 II. m.
 1. An ensign, MBh. 9, 3302.
 2. A distiller or seller of spirits, Man. 4, 84.
ध्वजिक ध्वजिक, i. e. ध्वजिन् + क, adj. One who displays the flag of virtue, a hypocrite, Man. 13, 7594.

ध्वजिन् ध्वजिन्, i. e. ध्वज + इन्,
 I. adj., f. नी, Furnished with, or bearing, a flag, Rām. 3, 28, 32; Man. 11, 92.
 II. m.
 1. An ensign, MBh. 1, 7765.
 2. A distiller or seller of spirits, Yājñ. 1, 141.
 --Comp.
† ध्वञ्ज् ध्वञ्ज्, i. 1, Par. = ध्वज्.
† ध्वण् ध्वण्, i. 1, Par. To sound.

1. ध्वन् ध्वन्, Par. To cover one's self.
 --Ptcple. of the pf. pass. ध्वान्त, n. Darkness, Rām. 2, 21, 53.

2. ध्वन् ध्वन्, i. 1, Par.
 1. To produce a sound, to roar, Ṛt. 1, 25.
 2. To buzz, Rājat. 5, 315.
 --Ptcple. of the pf. pass. ध्वनित, n.
 1. Sound, Megh. 43.
 2. Thunder, Kir. 5, 12.
 --Caus. and i. 10, ध्वा̆नय, To cause to sound, to strike, Śatr. 14, 223.
 --With अभि अभि, To sound, to hiss, Śiś. 20, 13.
 --With प्र प्र, To resound, 17, 31.
 --Cf. A.S. dynan, dyne.

ध्वनि ध्वन् + इ, m.
 1. Sound, Man. 4, 123.
 2. Figurative style, Sāh. D. 5, 9.
 --Comp.
ध्वसन्ति ध्वसन्ति, m. A proper name, Chr. 298, 23 = Rigv. i. 112, 23.
ध्वस्ति ध्वस्ति, i. e. ध्वंस् + ति, f. One of the four states of a Yogin, that in which all the consequences of actions cease, Mārk. P. 39, 22.
† ध्वाङ्क्ष् ध्वाङ्क्ष्, i. 1, Par. = ध्राङ्क्ष्.
ध्वाङ्क्ष ध्वाङ्क्ष, m. A crow, Brāhmaṇ. 2, 17.
ध्वान ध्वान, i. e. ध्वन् + अ, m. Murmuring, sound, Prab. 73, 9.
ध्वान्त ध्वान्त, see 1. ध्वन्.
ध्वज- + पट ध्वज- + पट, m. a flag, a standard, Vikr. d. 4.
ध्वज- + यन्त्र ध्वज- + यन्त्र, n. an apparatus for planting the staff of a standard, Rām. 4, 13, 20.
ध्वज- + यष्टि ध्वज- + यष्टि, f. a flag-staff, Rām. 5, 12, 38.
